article_long_term_singleness.summary: Long-term singleness has a vocabulary of its own, and much of the trouble around it comes from using the wrong word. After reading this you can tell the state of being single from the story a person tells about it, name the words that describe it precisely, recognise the pressure underneath it, and answer the questions other people ask without apologising for the answer.
article_long_term_singleness.title: The Psychology of Long-Term Singleness
